cases.name: Strong message, uses her back pain

output.message: Namaste Priya! You told us your back aches after cooking. Today, try the cat-cow back stretch after you finish in the kitchen. Get on your hands and knees on a folded blanket. Breathe in and let your belly drop gently. Breathe out and round your back up. Do this 5 times, slowly. If your knees hurt, put a pillow under them. Ask someone at home to stay close by. Stop if you feel pain, dizziness or see any bleeding, and go to your nearest health centre or call 108 right away. For other questions, reply here to talk to a Noora nurse. Were you able to try it today? Reply 1 for Yes, 2 for No.

cases.name: Vague, long and full of jargon

output.message: Dear Divya, as you move through your pregnancy it is very important to keep your body active and flexible, and doing some light stretching exercises every morning can be a wonderful way to care for yourself and your growing baby. You can also do some pelvic floor exercises, which many women find useful during this special time, but try not to stay supine for too long. Go slowly if you feel tired and listen to your body at all times. Ask your mother-in-law to join you so that you both stay active together. Stretching should feel gentle and never painful. Stop if you feel pain, dizziness or see any bleeding, or if anything feels different from usual, and go to your nearest health centre or call 108 right away. For other questions, reply here to talk to a Noora nurse. We are always here for you and your family whenever you need us. Were you able to try it today? Reply 1 for Yes, 2 for No.
